plan.notes: Source: official USI 'BS Computer Science Degree Map' (Math 085 entry track), Romain College of Business, 'Created Spring 2025 - Subject to Change', https://www.usi.edu/media/31blsrsx/bs-computer-science-map-math-085-1.pdf - the only official term-by-term sequence USI publishes for the Computer Science Major, B.S.; hand-transcribed 2026-09-30 from the PDF. Course titles verified against the official USI bulletin (2025-2026 course descriptions and the 2021-2022 CS degree planner at bulletin.usi.edu): MATH 085 Foundations for College Algebra; MATH 111 College Algebra; MATH 215 Survey of Calculus; ENG 101 Rhetoric and Composition I / ENG 201 Rhetoric and Composition II; CMST 101 Introduction to Public Speaking / CMST 107 Introduction to Interpersonal Communication; CS 215 Discrete Structures for Computer Science; CS 258 Introduction to Object-Oriented Programming Using C#; CS 311 Data Structures and Analysis of Algorithms; CS 321 Architecture of Digital Computers; CS 358 Advanced Object-Oriented Programming Using C#; CS 365 Operating Systems; CS 379 Programming Languages; CS 458 Advanced Programming in C#; CS 461 Artificial Intelligence; CS 478 Software Development; CS 483 Senior Software Development Project; CIS 367 Data Communications; CIS 375 Systems Analysis and Design; CIS 377 Introduction to Database Concepts; ECE 241 Digital Logic; ECE 347 Microcomputer Engineering; BCOM 231 Business Communication; BCOM 361 Business Career Planning and Professional Development; KIN 192 Fitness/Wellness. Catalog year set to 2025-2026 (the map prints 'Created Spring 2025' but no catalog year; 2025-2026 is the current published bulletin edition). CREDIT DISCREPANCY: the map's printed term totals are 16+16+16+16+16+15+15+15 = 125, but summing the individual course credits as printed yields 126 (Fall Year 2: 3+3+3+4+3+1 = 17, while the map prints 16 for that term - the map's own term arithmetic is inconsistent). total_credits is set to 126, the course-level sum of the sequence exactly as published, per pipeline precedent of using the sequence's own total; both the map's printed 125 and the catalog's 120-credit baccalaureate minimum (USI program page: Gen Ed 39 + Major 65 + Additional 16 = 120) are documented here. MATH 085 caveat: the 2025-2026 bulletin lists MATH 085 as 4 credits whose 'Credit in this course will not apply to a degree'; the map (created Spring 2025) lists it at 3 credits - transcribed exactly as the map prints it. Placement: ENG 101 and MATH 085 require satisfactory placement scores (no placement course codes used in prereq fields). Either/or prereqs from the map, pointed at the in-plan course and documented here: CS 358 lists 'CS 201 or CS 258' (CS 201 is not in the plan - pointed at CS 258); ECE 241 lists 'MATH 111, 118, 215, or 230' (pointed at MATH 111, taken the prior spring); CS 311 lists 'CS 215 and either CS 301 or CS 358' (pointed at CS 215 + CS 358); CS 458 lists 'CS 301 or CS 358' (pointed at CS 358); MATH 111 lists 'MATH 082/085' (pointed at MATH 085). Standing requirements from the map (not course codes, documented here): CIS 367, CIS 375, CIS 377 require junior standing; BCOM 361 requires BCOM 231 and junior standing (pointed at the BCOM 231/ENG 317 choice slot per the map); CS 478 requires CS 311 and senior standing; CS 483 requires senior standing. The map lists CS Directed Elective slots (4 x 3 credits = 12 hours) with no option list printed; options shown are the 'Directed Electives (12 hours)' list from the official USI bulletin CS degree planner - options are illustrative of the directed-elective pool, not from the map itself. Core 39 category abbreviations are the map's own: NS (Natural Science), WLS, WoK (Ways of Knowing: CAE/HI/MER/SMI/SI categories), SS (Social Science), NSL (Natural Science with Lab), DEE/WEE/GEE (Embedded Experiences); option lists are the map's 'Most Common Core 39 Courses for CS Majors'.
